questions.text: Which type of emotional expression dataset is easiest to collect but suffers from low ecological validity?
In emotion elicitation, which method involves observing film clips or images designed to evoke emotions?
A key disadvantage of using images for passive elicitation is:
options: Emotional reactions are short and transient
questions.correctAnswer: Emotional reactions are short and transient

questions.text: Which passive method generally includes a neutral baseline clip before emotional clips?
Directed Facial Action Tasks are primarily used in:
One major advantage of social interaction–based elicitation is:
options: The emotions elicited are highly controllable
It is effective for collecting productive modalities
Emotions produced are realistic and natural
questions.correctAnswer: Emotions produced are realistic and natural

questions.text: Which document is required when submitting a study for IRB review?
options: A published version of the experiment
A copy of the informed consent form
questions.correctAnswer: A copy of the informed consent form

questions.text: Which of the following is not a criterion for IRB approval?
options: Risks to subjects must be minimized
Selection of subjects must be equitable

questions.text: Tools such as PsychoPy, OpenSesame, and SuperLab fall under which category?
SAM (Self-Assessment Manikin) is primarily used for:
options: Measuring emotional responses along dimensions like valence and arousal
questions.correctAnswer: Measuring emotional responses along dimensions like valence and arousal
